note: LE.4a scope addition (from LG.3b). Every statement is a call argument inside a function, the shape the Go parser's own per-call-argument SQL scan read with none of LG.3b's rejects: quokka-stack's fmt.Errorf("delete from spaces key=%q: %w") minted sql:spaces, lapse's CTE aliases (opp_ids / task_counts / chosen_brief / tc / cb / response_outcomes / pursuit_outcomes) and DO UPDATE SET's SET became tables, and Kina's SQL comment `... interleave into a downgrade` minted sql:a. LE.4a deletes that scanner: the data-entities extractor reads every SQL literal and the engine re-homes its edge to the enclosing function, so the function-level edges below come from the extractor and the module keeps none. No cells binding: a precision guard.
